capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Lexus USA: both BEVs use the "same 74.7-kWh lithium-ion battery pack"; InsideEVs: 74.7 kWh (gross).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists 71.0 kWh usable for the 74.7 kWh pack (bZ4X Touring AWD MY26); the ES uses the same 74.7 kWh pack (Lexus ES release). A UK ES listing reportedly gives 72.0 usable (not opened).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: The 74.7 kWh pack keeps the same NMC chemistry and cells (Toyota chief engineer, Autopian); the ES uses the same 74.7 kWh pack (Lexus ES release).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: The 74.7 kWh pack runs on a 400-volt architecture (Toyota chief engineer, InsideEVs); the ES uses the same pack (Lexus ES release).

preconditioning.notes: "Battery Preconditioning further helps optimize charging speeds"; started from the touchscreen or triggered automatically when a public charger is the destination (Drive Connect trial or subscription required).

dc_max_kw.notes: Level 3 charging 10-80% about 28 min, "speeds up to 150 kW".

published_10_80_min.notes: About 28 min 10-80% (the release headline says about 30).
